d:
Rajdhani patna men ganga nadi ke kinare sanchalit ho rahe eent-bhatthon ke khilaph jila prashasan ne bara buldojar ekshan liya hai. somvar ko didarganj ilake men huee is karravaee ke dauran eent-bhatthon ke nirman aur sanchalan se jure avaidh dhanchon tatha bari-bari chimniyon ko mashinon ki madad se dhvast kar diya gaya. prashasan ki is sakht karravaee ke bad pure ilake men harkanp mach gaya hai.
Ganga path ke pilar par mandra raha tha khatra, sthaniy logon ne ki thi shikayat
